current.label: Current model
current.description: Six months with a four-day immersion.

fourStage.label: Four-stage pathway
fourStage.note: Each stage is purchased separately. Stopping at any stage counts as complete.

prerequisite.name: Wilderness First Aid or Wilderness First Responder

verbs.label: Book a place
verbs.friction: Pick a date and pay. No application.

verbs.label: Enroll
verbs.friction: Application, cohort start date, mentor assigned.

offerings.name: Re-collection
offerings.proposition: Learn the practice for your own life. Decide about guiding later.
offerings.format: Online, plus mentored fieldwork near you
offerings.isNot: Not a certification, and not a commitment to one. Many people stop here on purpose.
offerings.context: Stage 1 of four. All four total $3,545.

offerings.name: Immersion
offerings.proposition: Where understanding becomes embodiment. Most guides change here.
offerings.bookIncluded: Your Guide to Forest Bathing — A Journal: Invitations for Practice and Reflection
offerings.isNot: Not the place to begin. Re-collection comes first, and the immersion lands two to ten months in.
offerings.context: Stage 2 of four. All four total $3,545.

offerings.name: Practicum
offerings.proposition: Supervised practice held to a standard worth certifying.
offerings.format: Online, with fieldwork you run yourself
offerings.bookIncluded: A Guide's Handbook of Forest Therapy — print, exclusive to participants
offerings.isNot: Not a guarantee of certification. This is the stage where you are assessed, and some people are asked to do more.
offerings.context: Stage 3 of four. All four total $3,545.

offerings.name: Practice
offerings.proposition: Turns a certificate into a livelihood. The stage we never had.
offerings.isNot: Not general business training, and not required for certification. It is about earning a living from this practice specifically.
offerings.context: Stage 4 of four. All four total $3,545.

offerings.name: The Guild
offerings.proposition: Replaces membership. Meets the real need, not the conventional one.

price.note: About $92 an atelier across 26 a year

offerings.format: An atelier every other week, online
offerings.prerequisite: Guide certification or completion of Opus Academy
offerings.isNot: Not a benefits package and not a directory listing you buy. You belong by contributing, and what you bring is held in common.
offerings.context: Open to certified guides and to Opus graduates. Replaces the membership program.

offerings.name: The Forest Threshold
offerings.proposition: A doorway for people who arrive looking, not shopping.

price.note: Six cohorts a year, 18 places each

offerings.isNot: Not an introduction to our trainings. Nobody will sell you anything while you are here.
offerings.context: No prerequisite. Held by the Academy of Applied Forest Therapy.

offerings.name: Council of Waters and Trees
offerings.proposition: For those who want to hold gatherings, not only walks.
offerings.isNot: Not a guide training and not a route to certification. This is council practice.

offerings.name: Healing Trails
offerings.proposition: Carries the practice into landscapes and the institutions holding them.
offerings.isNot: Not a way into guiding. Certification comes first, and this is what you can do with it.
offerings.context: Consultants and ambassadors for the Certified Trails Network.

offerings.name: Opus Academy
offerings.proposition: The transformational path. Not a credential, and not sold as one.
offerings.isNot: Not a professional qualification. It will not make you a guide and is not intended to.
offerings.context: Opens the Guild. Alchemy of Pilgrimage.

offerings.name: Nature as Medicine
offerings.proposition: The practice in clinical vocabulary, for people who hold a license.

price.note: All meals created on site by a chef

offerings.isNot: Not a guide certification. It will not qualify you to guide.
offerings.context: Accredited by Mass General Brigham. Up to 86 continuing education credits. In partnership with Dr. Susan Abookirie of Harvard Medical School.

offerings.name: Guiding in sign language
offerings.proposition: The practice in a language the deaf community shapes itself.
offerings.format: Taught by deaf trainers, for deaf guides
offerings.isNot: Not an interpreted version of the standard training. The vocabulary and the culture belong to the deaf community to choose.
offerings.context: In development. Full certification on the same standard.

offerings.name: Bespoke
offerings.proposition: Brought to an organization's own people and their own land.

price.note: Priced per engagement rather than per seat

offerings.isNot: Not a discounted route to certification for individuals. This is for organizations.
